mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS closedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (10,20,30,35,40) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS openCount, COALESCE(SUM(downtime_minutes), 0) AS downtimeMinutes, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN finish_time IS NOT NULL THEN downtime_minutes END)), 0) AS mttrMinutes, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN accept_time IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, report_time, accept_time) END)), 0) AS responseMinutes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eq_inspection_record r WHERE r.result = 2 AND r.record_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}) AS abnormalRecordCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eq_inspection_record r WHERE r.record_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}) AS inspectionCount FROM wo_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND report_time >= #{from} AND report_time < DATE_ADD(#{to}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(a.workshop, ''), '未分配') AS workshop, COUNT(o.id) AS orderCount, COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) AS assetCount, COALESCE(SUM(o.downtime_minutes), 0) AS downtimeMinutes, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN o.finish_time IS NOT NULL THEN o.downtime_minutes END)), 0) AS mttrMinutes, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN o.accept_time IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, o.report_time, o.accept_time) END)), 0) AS responseMinutes FROM wo_order o JOIN eq_asset a ON a.id = o.asset_id AND a.deleted = 0 WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.report_time >= #{from} AND o.report_time < DATE_ADD(#{to}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(a.workshop, ''), '未分配') ORDER BY downtimeMinutes DESC

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(fault_type, ''), '未分类') AS faultType, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(downtime_minutes), 0) AS downtimeMinutes FROM wo_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND report_time >= #{from} AND report_time < DATE_ADD(#{to}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(fault_type, ''), '未分类') ORDER BY orderCount DESC

SELECT DATE(report_time) AS statDate, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(downtime_minutes), 0) AS downtimeMinutes FROM wo_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND report_time >= #{from} AND report_time < DATE_ADD(#{to}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(report_time) ORDER BY statDate
